declaration.preface: A Sustainable Procurement Policy establishes a framework for responsible sourcing that aligns with environmental and social governance principles. It aims to integrate sustainability into the procurement process by prioritizing suppliers that demonstrate ethical practices, use sustainable materials, and minimize environmental impact. By emphasizing lifecycle assessments and supplier engagement, the policy seeks to foster long-term partnerships that contribute to economic, social, and environmental well-being. Ultimately, this commitment enhances the organization's reputation, supports sustainable development goals, and mitigates risks associated with unsustainable practices. Through sustainable procurement, organizations can significantly impact their supply chains and promote a more sustainable future​.
declaration.declaration:
Promote Environmental Responsibility: Ensure that procurement decisions prioritize environmentally friendly products and services, aiming to reduce the overall carbon footprint of the organization and minimize waste.

Support Ethical Sourcing: Engage suppliers who adhere to fair labor practices, respect human rights, and promote social equity, fostering a responsible supply chain that benefits communities.

Encourage Innovation: Drive the development and adoption of sustainable products and technologies by collaborating with suppliers to find innovative solutions that enhance sustainability.

Enhance Supplier Engagement: Build long-term relationships with suppliers committed to sustainability, providing them with guidance and resources to improve their environmental and social practices.

Measure and Report Performance: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the effectiveness of sustainable procurement practices, enabling transparent reporting to stakeholders and continuous improvement.

Educate and Train Staff: Provide training and resources to procurement staff to enhance their understanding of sustainable procurement practices and their importance to the organization’s mission and values.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all Plastipak employees, contractors, third-party partners, and internal and external stakeholders, including customers directly or indirectly associated with Plastipak. It extends across all offices, headquarters, facilities, and operating sites where Plastipak engages in procurement activities. The policy ensures that sustainable practices are integrated into all aspects of the procurement process, promoting responsible sourcing of materials and services across the organization’s global operations.

Environmental Considerations in Procurem: We aim to lower our carbon footprint by choosing suppliers dedicated to reducing greenhouse gas emissions in their operations and logistics.
We strive to source sustainable materials by selecting products that are renewable, recycled, or have a minimal environmental impact to promote resource conservation.
We seek to minimize waste generation by collaborating with suppliers to develop strategies that reduce packaging and encourage recycling practices.
We are committed to conserving natural resources by partnering with suppliers that demonstrate responsible use of water, energy, and raw materials in their production processes.
We prioritize suppliers with recognized environmental certifications, such as ISO 14001, to ensure they adhere to sustainability best practices.
We aim to conduct routine sustainability assessments to evaluate suppliers’ environmental practices, ensuring alignment with our green procurement standards.
We seek to embed environmental awareness within procurement teams by third party online training, staff to recognize xand prioritize sustainable sourcing opportunities.
Our focus is to integrate energy, waste, and GHG considerations into procurement decisions, favoring suppliers committed to emission reductions.
We strive to prioritize suppliers using eco-friendly materials and adopting circular economy practices across their operations.
We will ensure compliance with environmental regulations by engaging only with suppliers adhering to applicable standards and sustainability benchmarks.
Social Considerations in Procurement: We are dedicated to ensuring fair labor practices by collaborating with suppliers who provide fair wages, maintain safe working conditions, and promote non-discrimination in their workplaces.
We aim to contribute to community development by sourcing from suppliers that invest in local communities and positively impact their social and economic growth.
We focus on promoting diversity and inclusion by engaging a wide range of suppliers, including minority-owned and women-owned businesses, to foster inclusivity in our supply chain.
We advocate for human rights by ensuring that all suppliers adhere to international human rights standards and protect their workforce's rights.
We seek to enhance training and development opportunities by partnering with suppliers to offer skill-building initiatives that improve career prospects for their employees.
We aim to establish a supplier diversity program that increases engagement with underrepresented businesses, including minority- and women-owned enterprises.
We focus on evaluating suppliers based on fair labor practices and fostering a safe, equitable work environment within their operations.
We strive to embed social responsibility principles into procurement training to empower our staff to make ethical and impactful sourcing decisions.
We are committed to engaging suppliers with community outreach programs that align with our values of social inclusion and development.
Our objective is to ensure compliance with labor and human rights standards by prioritizing partnerships with socially responsible suppliers.
Governance Considerations in Procurement: We strive to guarantee compliance with regulations by implementing robust processes that ensure all procurement activities align with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards.
We endeavor to adopt effective risk management practices to identify and assess risks associated with suppliers, including their financial stability, reputational risks, and ethical considerations.
We are committed to establishing accountability measures by creating frameworks for monitoring supplier performance and ensuring responsibility for ethical and sustainable practices.
We focus on engaging stakeholders in the procurement process to gather insights and feedback, thereby enhancing governance and decision-making.
We aim to introduce a supplier performance scorecard to monitor compliance, ethical practices, and sustainability commitments within the supply chain.
We seek to integrate governance frameworks into procurement decisions by assessing suppliers' adherence to anti-corruption laws and ethical guidelines.
Our focus is to train employees involved in procurement on governance and compliance requirements to promote responsible sourcing.
We strive to ensure transparency across procurement operations by engaging only with suppliers demonstrating integrity and accountability.
We aim to enforce compliance with legal and governance standards by regularly auditing procurement activities for adherence to ethical practices.

targets.target: We aim to reduce the carbon footprint of suppliers, including local ones, by 20% by 2026, by prioritizing vendors actively pursuing greenhouse gas reduction initiatives.
Increase the number of suppliers with recognized environmental certifications (e.g., ISO 14001) by 30% to align with our environmental objectives.
Ensure 100% of procurement staff are trained on sustainable procurement practices to identify suppliers committed to reducing their environmental impact.
Ensure 100% compliance with fair labor practices, such as fair wages and safe working conditions, among suppliers.
Increase procurement from minority-owned and women-owned businesses by 40% through the implementation of a supplier diversity program.
Ensure 100% of suppliers hold social responsibility certifications (e.g., SA8000, Fair Trade) to promote ethical labor practices.
Train 100% of procurement staff on social responsibility, labor standards, and diversity practices to promote equitable and inclusive sourcing.
Achieve 100% supplier compliance with our governance policies through regular audits and adherence to ethical and legal standards.
Ensure all procurement staff receive governance training, with a 100% increase in staff trained compared to the 2022 baseline.
Enhance procurement oversight by auditing 100% of critical suppliers annually to ensure compliance with governance and risk management frameworks.

policy.monitoring:
We will produce annual reports that outline our sustainable procurement performance, measuring progress against defined metrics such as environmental outcomes, supplier engagement in sustainability practices, and community impact.

These reports will be made available to stakeholders—including employees, clients, suppliers, and investors—to promote transparency and responsibility.

Continuous monitoring will be established to ensure alignment with our sustainability goals and to identify areas needing enhancement.

Routine compliance audits will be conducted to ensure that our sustainability standards, corporate policies, and operational objectives are consistently met.

The outcomes of these audits will be evaluated by senior management, who will implement necessary corrective actions for any deficiencies identified.

A third-party evaluation may be utilized to provide an objective assessment of our compliance with sustainability practices.

We will actively engage stakeholders through surveys, consultations, and focus groups to gather feedback on our sustainable procurement practices and discover potential improvements.

Collaborating with stakeholders will allow us to remain aligned with prevailing sustainability trends and industry best practices.

We will create dedicated forums or workshops for stakeholders to discuss sustainability challenges and opportunities in procurement.

A dedicated system will be established for employees, clients, and external stakeholders to report sustainability-related issues confidentially, without fear of repercussions.

All concerns will be thoroughly investigated, and appropriate measures will be implemented to address the issues raised.

Regular communication will be provided to stakeholders regarding the outcomes of reported concerns to reinforce trust in the mechanism.

We will publicly disclose essential sustainability metrics, accomplishments, and challenges on an annual basis through sustainability reports or dedicated sections of our website.

This commitment to openness underscores our resolve to maintain accountability regarding sustainable procurement practices.

We will also engage in public forums or events to share our sustainability journey and gather feedback from the community.

Governance of this policy ensures accountability at all levels, with the Board of Directors providing strategic oversight and establishing sustainability goals. Executive leadership integrates sustainability into procurement processes and monitors performance, while the Sustainability Director ensures regulatory compliance and reports progress. Department heads are responsible for implementing sustainable practices within their areas, promoting responsible sourcing and supplier engagement. Employees and contractors contribute to sustainability initiatives and provide feedback on improvements. Suppliers and partners collaborate to meet sustainability targets and uphold ethical practices. Regular audits, stakeholder engagement, and transparent reporting facilitate continuous improvement and alignment with evolving sustainability standards. Periodic reviews of governance structures will ensure their effectiveness in supporting sustainable procurement objectives.
policy.reviewMechanism:
We are resolutely committed to the continuous enhancement of our sustainable procurement practices by establishing measurable objectives, monitoring progress, and identifying areas for improvement. Regular compliance audits, performance evaluations, and stakeholder feedback will ensure that our practices remain effective and responsive to evolving sustainability trends. Additionally, benchmarking against industry best practices will inspire innovation and bolster our sustainable procurement initiatives.

Collaborative projects with suppliers will be pursued to develop innovative solutions that address sustainability challenges.

This policy will undergo an annual review to adapt to evolving regulations, technological advancements, and sustainability trends. Training programs and awareness initiatives will cultivate a culture of respect for sustainability among employees, empowering them to contribute actively to our sustainable procurement goals. Through collaboration with partners and suppliers, we aim to develop innovative solutions that bolster environmental stewardship and responsible sourcing throughout our supply chain.

We will leverage technology and data analytics to optimize procurement processes and enhance sustainability performance.

The Sustainability Director will conduct an annual review of this policy to assess its effectiveness and relevance. This process will encompass compliance assessments, performance metric analysis, and the identification of enhancement opportunities. Findings and recommendations will be documented and presented to management for consideration and implementation.
